title: AndroidWorld Open-Source & Source-Available Leaderboard
subtitle: Publicly released agent/model repositories across 116 AndroidWorld tasks (excludes closed-source submissions)
selection: User-selected representative open-source and source-available repositories; non-exhaustive, not an official ranking or certification of complete open-source evaluation stacks. Repository licenses apply only to the scoped components described per entry.
footnotes: Sources: Google Research AndroidWorld Leaderboard (archived Nov 2026) and public repositories. Closed-source entries (e.g., Lusor closed harness, GBOX cloud, Gemini 2.5 API) are omitted.
*FSQ: 95.69% (111/116 pass@1) under strict int(10×complexity) write-action caps, single model, zero app-specific skills; 113 stock tasks + 3 disclosed task-contract fixes.
Selected code-public entries; evaluation protocols, step budgets, and exact benchmarked commits vary across projects. Minitap 94.0% is pass³, not pass@1.
